product_metadata.title: Closet Complete Twirling Tie Rack / Hanger Organizer / Belt Rack, Rotates 360 Degrees, Holds 20 Ties or Belts
features: LARGE CAPACITY: Holds 20 ties or belts
360° SPINNING: This tie / belt organizer easily spins a full 360° making selection a SNAP! Anti-slip arms hold ties in place.
STANDARD SIZE HANGER HOOK: Fits all closet rods (Tie racks only, Ties not included)
description: Closet Complete America's Favorite Brand brings quality and value to the care of all your ties and belts with our 20 hook Twirling Tie Rack / Hanger Organizer. This handy twirling tie rack is a simple way to hang your favorite ties or belts, and makes selecting a tie to wear SO EASY!!! Non-Slip curved arms hold ties securely and prevents slipping. Durable construction, thin space saving design also maximizes closet space. Just fill with up to 20 ties and hang in your closet. THAT’S IT!!!
